data.body: S1 ee8a: PASS with 2 critical advisories. Applied E6/E1 (new vendor-constant AC named no concrete prefixes, so the scan was undefined — now names the literals x-litellm-, langfuse_, helicone- case-insensitively, excluding the test's own file). DEFERRED T7/T5e (no documentation named): documentation for this surface is delivered by sibling 98b6 per the epic decomposition; duplicating it in ee8a would create overlapping child responsibilities that G5 penalizes. Added a one-line pointer to 98b6 so the deferral is explicit in the plan.
